overview_description.description:
ZenHR (www.zenhr.com) is a cloud-first category leader in B2B HR SaaS targeted to the Middle East and North African region. At ZenHR, we are all about giving our users peace of mind. ZenHR is not just another HR software; it is a transformative HR experience created to help HR departments and employees reach a state of Zen. With our localized features and interface, including labor laws, social insurance, tax, expat regulations, General Organisation of Social Insurance (GOSI), and Wage Protection System (WPS), ZenHR's HRMS serves everyone from SME to Enterprise customers in the MENA market.

The state-of-the-art cloud-based HR software solutions that ZenHR offers change the game for HR departments and employees. With features like automated salary calculations and Employee Self Service (ESS), ZenHR puts employees in the driver's seat, making their lives easier and everyone happier. We are here to ensure that our customers have a delightful and seamless experience from the 'Acquire' stage all the way to the 'Retire' stage.
 ZenHR’s Modules:
Payroll
Attendance and Time-Tracking
Employee Self-Service (ESS)
Onboarding and Offboarding
Performance and Evaluation
Applicant Tracking System (ZenATS)
 
For more information: sales@zenhr.com

about_short_description.short_description: ZenHR (www.zenhr.com) is a cloud-first category leader in B2B HR SaaS targeted to the Middle East and North African region.

product.name: Payroll
product.description: Automates salary calculations, deductions, and maintains salary history with localization for regional social insurance, tax, and wage protection systems.

product.name: Attendance and Time-Tracking
product.description: Automates employee attendance and time tracking, providing real-time reports on attendance, shortages, and overtime.

product.name: Employee Self-Service (ESS)
product.description: Allows employees to manage HR tasks such as clocking in/out, viewing salary slips, requesting time off, and checking work schedules via web and mobile app.

product.name: Onboarding and Offboarding
product.description: Manages the processes of welcoming new hires and handling employee exits with customizable workflows and documentation.

product.name: Performance and Evaluation
product.description: Automates employee performance reviews and evaluations to align workforce goals with company objectives.

product.name: Applicant Tracking System (ZenATS)
product.description: Manages and tracks the entire recruitment process from application to job offer and acceptance.
